City Council and Community Development Commission Regular Meeting
AGENDA
la puente City Council and Community Development Commission Regular Meeting
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
MAY 10, 2011
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/COMMISSION MEMBERS: House, Mendoza, Solis, Argudo, Holloway
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF MILITARY BANNER CERTIFICATES
Military Banner Certificates
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
RECESS THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETING - None.
B.
PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
RECONVENE CITY COUNCIL
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF THE SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON (SCE) CALIFORNIA LONG-TERM ENERGY EFFICIENCY STRATEGIC PLAN (CEESP) MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS AND THE CITY OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council approve one of the following options: 1) approve the Southern California Edison (SCE) California Long-Term Energy Efficiency Strategic Plan (CEESP) Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments and the City of La Puente; or 2) not approve the MOU and continue the City's participation in the grant without the reimbursement of staff time.
CC.C-1 SCE CEESP MOU Report
CC.C-1 SCE CEESP MOU Transmittal Memo - Attachment A
CC.C-1 SCE CEESP MOU - ATTACHMENT B
C-2
DISCUSS AN AMENDMENT TO THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ALLOW THE CITY COUNCIL TO REVIEW PLANNING COMMISSION ACTIONS
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1296 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2010-11
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution approving Warrant Register No. 1296.
CC.D-1 Resolution Warrant Register #1296
D-2
SECOND READING - ADOPTION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING SECTIONS 2.12.010, AND 2.12.020 TO THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO APPOINTMENT, OF CITY TREASURER
It is recommended that the City Council:
1) Waive further reading of Ordinance and read by title only; and
2) Adopt Ordinance No. 11-914 - an Ordinance of the City of La Puente, amending Section 2.12.010 and 2.12.020 to the La Puente Municipal code relating to the appointment of the City Treasurer.
CC.D-2 HR Amend LPMC Sec 2.12 Treasurer-Report
CC.D-2 HR Amend LPMC Sec 2.12 Treasurer-Ordinance Attach A
D-3
SECOND READING - ADOPTION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, STATE OF CALIFORNIA, DELETING CHAPTER 2.14 OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO REFLECT THE ELIMINATION OF THE FINANCE DIRECTOR POSITION
It is recommended that the City Council:
1) Waive further reading of Ordinance and read by title only; and
2) Adopt Ordinance No. 11-915 - an Ordinance of the City of La Puente, deleting Chapter 2.14 of the City of La Puente Municipal Code to reflect the elimination of the Finance Director Position.
CC.D-3 Deleting Sections in LPMC Ordinance-Report
CC.D-3 Deleting Sections in LPMC Ordinance-Attach A
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF FIREWORKS SALES PERMITS FOR VETERANS GROUPS FOR THE 2011 INDEPENDENCE DAY SEASON
It is recommended that the City Council approve the issuance of permits to sell Safe and Sane Fireworks by Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 1944, American Legion Post 75, and American Legion Post Women's Auxiliary, pursuant to all applicable code requirements.
CC.D-4 Consideration of Fireworks Sales Permits Report
CC.D-4 Consideration of Fireworks Sales Attach A
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AMENDING THE CITY'S FISCAL YEAR 2010-2011 ADOPTED BUDGET
It is recommended that the City Council 1) adopt a Resolution amending the FY 2010 -11 Adopted Budget and 2) approve the amendment to agreement with James Corcoran and authorize the Interim City Manager to execute the agreement, subject to review and approval by the Interim City Attorney as to form.
CC.D-5 Fin FY 10-11 Budget Amendment Report
CC.D-5 Fin FY 10-11 Budget Amendment-Attach A
CC.D-5 Fin FY 10-11 Budget Amendment-Attach B
CC.D-5 Fin FY 10-11 Budget Amendment-Exh A
CC.D-5 Fin FY 10-11 Budget Amendment-Exh B
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF MAYOR'S APPOINTMENTS TO VARIOUS BOARD POSITIONS
It is recommended that 1) the Mayor make appointments to the various agency boards; and 2) the Council adopt the Resolution appointing specific representatives to the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments.
CC.E-1 REPORT.Council Appointments
CC.E-1 REPORT.ATTACHMENTA.Council Appointments Blank Att A
CC.E-1 Council Appointments List 2010 Att B
CC.E-1 REPORT.ATTACHMENTC.CouncilAppointmentsResolution Att C
E-2
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR THE SANITARY SEWER MAINTENANCE SERVICES IN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) approve the specifications for the Sanitary Sewer Maintenance Services in the City of La Puente; and 2) authorize staff to solicit bids.
CC.E-2 Auth to Solicit Bids-Sewer Maintenece Services
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE SUPPORTING A REORGANIZATION OF CITY PERSONNEL AND AMENDING THE CITY OF LA PUENTE CLASSIFICATION PLAN, COMPENSATION PLAN, AND TABLE OF ORGANIZATION
It is recommended that the City Council adopt a Resolution of supporting City reorganization and amending the City's Classification Plan, Compensation Plan and Table of Organization.
CC.E-3 HR Reorganization Reso - Report
CC.E-3 HR Reorganization Reso - Attach A
CC.E-3 HR Reorganization Reso (Org Chart) -Attach B
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 11-4928, AND AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM AND ESTABLISHING THE NUMBER OF AUTHORIZED POSITIONS, MONTHLY SALARY RANGES AND HOURLY RATES FOR CITY EMPLOYEES
It is recommended that the City Council adopt a Resolution rescinding Resolution No. 11-4928, and amending the comprehensive personnel system and establishing the number of authorized positions, monthly salary ranges and hourly rates for City employees.
CC.E-4 HR Rescinding Reso Amend Salary Schedule-Report
CC.E-4 HR Salary Resolution-Attach A
CC.E-4 HR Salary Schedule (Job Desc.) Resolution-Attach B
E-5
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, ADDING SECTION 2.13 TO THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO EXCEPTIONS TO THE CIVIL SERVICE SYSTEM
It is recommended that the City Council:
1) Waive further reading of the Ordinance and read by title only; and
2) Introduce the Ordinance-an Ordinance of the City of La Puente, adding Section 2.13 to the La Puente Municipal Code relating to exceptions to the Civil Service System.
CC.E-5 HR Civil Service Ordinance-Report
CC.E-5 HR Civil Service Ordinance-Attach A
E-6
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR PAYROLL/TIME & ATTENDANCE/HR AND BENEFITS ADMINISTRATION
It is recommended that the City Council award the Payroll/Time & Attendance/HR and Benefits Administration service contract to ADP in the amount of $11,870 per year and authorize the Mayor to sign the contract.
CC.E-6 HR Award AGMT ADP - Report
CC.E-6 HR Contract - Attach A
CC.E-6 HR ADP Exhibit A - Attach B
CC.E-6 HR Paychex - Attach C
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL AND RECONVENE THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION MEETING - None.
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS - None.
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR - None.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A LICENSE AGREEMENT BETWEEN JASMINE REAL ESTATE INVESTMENTS, LLC. AND THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION FOR CERTAIN IMPROVEMENTS TO THE APPROXIMATE 9.76 ACRES OF REAL PROPERTY, GENERALLY LOCATED AT THE NORTHWEST CORNER OF HACIENDA BOULEVARD AND FAIRGROVE AVENUE
It is recommended that the Commission approve the License Agreement with Jasmine Real Estate Investments, LLC
CDC.E-1 License Agreement Hacienda Fairgrove
ADJOURN THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION AND RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION
F.
CLOSED SESSION
F-1
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE 54957.6(f) TO CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR. AGENCY DESIGNATED REPRESENTATIVE: HAYDEE SAINZ, HUMAN RESOURCES MANAGER EMPLOYEE ORGANIZATION: SEIU LOCAL 721

THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS INTO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.9(b), SIGNIFICANT EXPOSURE TO LITIGATION, TO CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION THREE (3) CASES
